mappingRules.identity: Exact eight-digit source AGS only; no zero-padding or name-based municipal join. Five-digit district identifiers remain district observations and are excluded from town values.
mappingRules.evidence: Exact original raw cell lexemes, sheet, coordinates, source hash, source key, schema hash, mapping version; only this column's own header chain and table-title cells support semantics.
mappingRules.dates: Single explicit column/header year or unambiguous one-cell table-title year; annual December 31 statistical period end, debt stock reference date. Cash requires one explicit numbered quarter and represents January-through-quarter-end cumulative period. Missing or ambiguous year/quarter holds.
mappingRules.units: Explicit percent, EUR, 1000 EUR or EUR per inhabitant. Own column labels take priority, otherwise only an unambiguous one-cell table title supplies units. Conflicting labels or absent units hold the column; sibling columns never supply dimensions. German CSV numeric lexemes differ from native OOXML number lexemes. Numeric OOXML percentage-style tax-rate cells are scaled by 100 using the shared exact-decimal helper; style evidence and original raw lexemes remain attached. Plain numeric percentage columns are never rescaled from their magnitude or headers alone.
mappingRules.scope: Explicit core/special/consolidated labels from this column, otherwise an unambiguous one-cell title. Multiple conflicting scope labels hold the column. Tax series labelled tax_statistics only when no explicit scope exists, never guessed from sibling columns.
mappingRules.suppression: Empty, dot, ellipsis, slash, x and dash excluded, never zero-filled.
mappingRules.financialRole: none: statistics do not assert appropriation, project payment or municipal actual-account document.
mappingRules.coverage: Parsed supported cells remain partial because live resource completeness has not been established. Unrecognized schema held_quality, captured access wall blocked_access, explicit withdrawal partial without inferred deletion, unknown rights held_origin. Empty native snapshot empty.
